To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
LINE-2 (a type of transposable element) is a major source of human miRNA genes, and that LINE-2-derived miRNAs target genes with LINE-2 sequences in their 5’-UTR.

we have discovered a new class of miRNAs derived from LINE-2 elements that are expressed in human tissues and target transcripts containing fragments of LINE-2 elements, and that this network may play a role in the regulation of housekeeping genes and may be perturbed in glioma.

LINE-2 elements, which entered human genome 100–300 millions of years ago, are a source for functional human microRNAS and that these LINE-2 miRNAs target protein-coding genes with fragments of LINE-2 sequences in their 5’UTR.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification and functional characterization of transposable element (TE)-derived microRNAs (TE-miRNAs) in the human genome.
the role of transposable elements in the human genome.
the role of transposable elements in shaping gene expression in human cells.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
LINE-2 elements in the human genome are a source of miRNAs and target sequences that regulate the transcriptional levels of a large number of genes.
LINE-2 transposable element-derived miRNAs and their target sites are involved in post-transcriptional regulation in human tissues, and that this network is dysregulated in glioblastomas.
this study identifies L2-derived miRNAs in brain tissue, and shows that L2-mRNAs target L2-derived sequences within the 3’UTRs of protein-coding genes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we identified a new family of miRNAs derived from LINE-2 retrotransposons, and that this family of miRNAS targets protein-coding genes that carry fragments of the LINE-2 consensus sequence in their 3'UTR.
L2-mRNAs and their target sites are expressed ubiquitously in human tissues and that the network of L2-miRNA and their target sites is perturbed in cancer.
LINE2-derived microRNAs are a source of human microRNAs that target genes with LINE2-derived sequences in the 3’ UTR.
The main takeaway from our work is that
LINE2-derived sequences can function as miRNA target sites.
L2-derived miRNAs and their target sites are conserved in the human population, and that they are expressed in multiple tissues.
transposable elements are an important source of functional miRNA and target sites.
